note: Per-tenant approval store partitions (libs/core/governance/approval-store-location.ts, TENANT_APPROVAL_ROOT_PATH): <personal|confidential>/<tenant>/<channel>/requests/<id>.json, passkey-challenges/<id>.json and the channel's append-only approvals.jsonl event log, for every approval whose scope names a tenant (except tenant-activation requests for a tenant that is not yet active, which stay in active/shared/coordination/channels/). Decision records and their event history are audit evidence, so no TTL deletion; personal/confidential subtrees are tenant_scope protected prefixes, read and written as the tenant-bound tenant_approval_store role; tenant offboarding exports and soft-deletes a tenant's partitions.
